title: 第109章 这个转折非常好！

content_zh: 炎文帝看着众人那要吃人的目光，又看了一眼唐逸。　　啧，看来是朕想多了。　　这家伙似乎自带仇恨体质，根本就不需要朕拱火，他自己就能把火烧得旺旺的。　　虽说这就是炎文帝想要的效果，只是此时看到所有人对唐逸所表现出来的敌意，他还是忍不住愤怒。　　他能大概猜出唐逸的想法，他是以己为饵引诱东虞和北狄的人参与，打败北狄和东虞使团参赛的人，振奋大炎士气。　　可是，大炎的那些权贵豪族这时候却都想要他死！　　至于今日被北狄和东虞踩在脚下，很重要吗？对他们来说一点都不重要，反正大炎不是一直被北狄和东虞压着吗？　　被踩在脚下才很正常吧！　　他们脊梁骨已经碎了，可他这个皇帝，还有唐逸等年轻一辈的脊梁还想挺直。　　“好，朕准了！就看今日的龙争虎斗，谁能更胜一筹吧！”　　炎文帝坐回椅子，看向孔明箴道：“太傅，开始吧，朕也很好奇，今日诗岚那丫头会给咱们大炎的这群士子才子，准备什么样的题目呢。”　　孔明箴嘴角带笑，心头却不断抽搐。　　陛下，你这话已经说了好几次了。　　这次应该不会有意外了吧？我这把老骨头可经不起你们这么折腾了啊！　　沉吟了一下确定没有发生意外，孔明箴看向阁楼走过来的孔诗岚，道：“岚儿，既然陛下已经下旨，那便开始吧！”　　“沈园诗会，接下来便交给你了。”　　说这话时孔明箴下意识看了一眼唐逸，见到少年站在舞台上脸色从容而自信，老眼不由微微一黯。　　哎，多好的孩子呀！　　明明可以是孙女婿，怎么就便宜了陛下了呢！　　他自然看得出来，炎文帝闹得这么大，完全是在给唐逸铺路。　　只是此时唐逸没有看孔明箴一眼，他的注意力都集中在了孔诗岚的身上。　　不得不说孔诗岚应该是他穿越到这个世界，见到的最漂亮最有魅力的女人了，一身拖地长裙搭在她凹凸有致的身上，简直宛若仙子临尘，高贵典雅，冰清玉洁。　　可远观而不可亵玩！　　饶是他两世为人，心脏这时也不由漏跳了几拍。　　舞台上，一群参赛的才子学子，这时也都眼神炙热。　　特别是唐画，此时激动的手都攥成了拳，在心头已经将孔诗岚当成了禁脔，这种女人除了他以外，天下何人配得上？！　　孔诗岚也没有废话，给炎文帝敛衽行了一礼，美眸便落在了舞台上。　　“既然诸位都已经知道孔家举办沈园诗会的目的，那我也就不多费口舌了。”　　孔诗岚美眸掠过舞台。　　视线最终停留在了唐逸的身上。　　美眸中有些许复杂。　　到现在她都依旧有些难以置信，这家伙竟然就是她心心念念的小诗仙。　　但他的身上，完全看不到一点文采风流的样子啊！　　见到唐逸冲着自己微微颔首，孔诗岚才回过神，继续道：“想必诸位也曾猜过我一个小女子，会出什么样的题目。”　　“其实我的题目，和沈园有关。”　　听到这话，众人顿时面面相觑，人群中更是响起了窸窸窣窣的议论声。　　和沈园有关？沈园已经建造几百年，和沈园有关的事情多了去了。　　孔诗岚没有理会周围的议论，继续道：“沈园因何而出名？是因为沈园，记录了一段前朝一段凄美的爱情故事。”　　“前朝大将军陆放翁和唐玉儿原本是一对伉俪情深的夫妻，但陆母怕唐玉儿影响到儿子的前程，生生将其拆散……”　　孔诗岚的声音空灵，传遍全场。　　然而唐逸听着这故事，脸色顿时变得怪异起来。　　我勒个去！　　这个故事有点熟悉啊！　　这不是陆游和唐婉的故事吗？　　而记录他们凄美爱情的，就是那两首钗头凤啊！　　“在池台的正中，像当初的怀中，隔太多春秋会不能相拥，还没到开满花，却看到天边一点点变红……”　　唐逸差点就唱出来了。　　沈园外嘛，某音上挺火的。　　但很快唐逸整个人都不好了，听起来像是开卷考试，可鬼知道孔诗岚这小妞在想什么？他要是让所有人写一首歌咏这段爱情故事的诗词，那就扯淡了。　　没得抄啊！　　这时，孔诗岚的声音传来：“陆将军和唐小姐分离三年后，北边蛮夷犯边，朝廷命陆将军率军北上，收复失地。”　　“在出征前，陆将军重游沈园，意外和唐小姐邂逅。”　　“知道他即将出征，唐小姐便排酒为将军壮行，而将军率军北上，收复大片被蛮夷占领的土地，最终阵前力战而亡。”　　“唐小姐收到噩耗，大病一场，也随将军而去了。”　　虽然这故事很多人都知道，但听完孔诗岚的话，很多世家姑娘还是红了眼睛。　　孔诗岚抿了抿唇，道：“如此凄美爱情，与之有关的诗词少之又少……”　　完了，完了，真是怕什么来什么！　　唐逸喉咙下意识滚动了下，端起茶杯狠狠灌了一口茶，却听孔诗岚道：“我的题目，便是以唐姑娘给陆将军敬酒壮行时陆将军心头所念，写一首诗或词……”　　噗！　　唐逸一口茶当场喷了出去，弯腰一阵猛咳。　　所有人的目光，齐齐落在唐逸身上。　　就连孔诗岚，美眸也是看了过来，唇角勾起一抹危险的弧度：“怎么？小诗仙是觉得我的题目太简单吗？”　　“不是，不是……”唐逸连连摆手。　　他抬手擦掉嘴角的茶水，笑道：“说实话，我只是没想到是这样的转折，我还以为你还让我们写一首歌咏这段爱情的诗词。”　　“嗯，转折转得非常好，非常的妙。”　　哈哈，这样一来，我又可以开始开卷考试了。　　闻言，很多人的脸色也都黑了。　　他们听到孔诗岚讲这个故事的时候，也和唐逸一样，觉得孔诗岚是想要让他们写一首有关这段凄美爱情的诗词。　　甚至他们都已经开始打好腹稿了。　　结果，孔诗岚竟然来了一个这样的转折。　　连他们都猝不及防好吧！　　写唐玉儿给陆将军敬酒时，陆将军的当时的心情？　　这是什么鬼题目哦！
content_en: Emperor Yanwen looked at everyone's cannibalistic eyes and glanced at Tang Yi again.Tsk, it seems that I have overthought it.This guy seems to have a body of hatred. He doesn't need me to support the fire at all. He can make the fire prosperous by himself.Although this was the effect Emperor Yan Wen wanted, he still couldn't help but be angry when he saw everyone's hostility towards Tang Yi.He could roughly guess what Tang Yi was thinking. He was using himself as bait to lure people from Dongyu and Beidi to participate, defeat those from Beidi and Dongyu delegations, and boost the morale of Great Yan.However, the powerful and wealthy people in Dayan all wanted him dead at this time!As for being stepped on by Beidi and Dongyu today, is it important?It's not important to them at all. After all, hasn't Dayan been suppressed by Beidi and Dongyu?It’s normal to be stepped on!Their spines have been broken, but he, the emperor, and the younger generation like Tang Yi still want to straighten their spines."Okay, I'm sure! Let's see who can win in today's battle between dragons and tigers!" Emperor Yanwen sat back in his chair, looked at Kong Mingzhen and said, "Master, let's get started. I'm also very curious about what kind of questions that girl Shilan will prepare for our group of scholars and talents in Dayan today." Kong Mingzhen's mouth was smiling, but his heart kept twitching.Your Majesty, you have said this several times.There shouldn’t be any surprises this time, right?My old bones can't stand your torment like this!After pondering for a while to make sure there was no accident, Kong Mingzhen looked at Kong Shilan who was coming from the loft and said, "Lan'er, since His Majesty has given the decree, let's get started!" "The Shenyuan Poetry Club, I'll leave it to you next." When he said this, Kong Mingzhen glanced at Tang Yi subconsciously, and when he saw the young man standing on the stage with a calm and confident face, his old eyes couldn't help but darken slightly.Oh, what a good boy!You can obviously be your grandson-in-law, so why is it so easy for Your Majesty?Of course he could see that Emperor Yanwen was making such a big fuss just to pave the way for Tang Yi.But Tang Yi didn't look at Kong Mingzhen at this time, and his attention was focused on Kong Shilan.I have to say that Kong Shilan is probably the most beautiful and charming woman he has ever seen when he traveled to this world. The floor-length dress draped over her curvy body made her look like a fairy on earth, noble and elegant, pure and pure.You can watch it from a distance but don’t play with it!Even though he had lived in two lifetimes, his heart couldn't help but skip a few beats at this time.On the stage, a group of talented students participating in the competition also had hot eyes.Especially Tang Hua. At this time, his excited hands were clenched into fists, and he already regarded Kong Shilan as a forbidden wife in his heart. Who else in the world could be worthy of such a woman besides him?!Kong Shilan didn't talk nonsense. She bowed to Emperor Yan Wen with her turban, and her beautiful eyes fell on the stage."Since everyone already knows the purpose of the Kong family's Shenyuan Poetry Recital, I won't waste any more words." Kong Shilan's beautiful eyes swept across the stage.His eyes finally rested on Tang Yi.There is something complicated in the beautiful eyes.Even now, she still can't believe that this guy is actually the little poetry fairy she has longed for.But there is absolutely no trace of literary grace or grace in him!Seeing Tang Yi nodding slightly at him, Kong Shilan came back to his senses and continued: "You must have guessed what kind of questions I, a little girl, would ask." "Actually, my questions are related to Shen Yuan." After hearing this, everyone immediately looked at each other, and rustling comments could be heard in the crowd.Is it related to Shen Yuan?Shen Garden has been built for hundreds of years, and there are many things related to Shen Garden.Kong Shilan ignored the surrounding discussions and continued: "Why is Shen Yuan famous? It's because Shen Yuan recorded a poignant love story from the previous dynasty." "The former general Lu Fangweng and Tang Yu'er were originally a loving couple, but Lu's mother was afraid that Tang Yu'er would affect her son's future, so she broke them up..." Kong Shilan's voice was ethereal and spread throughout the audience.However, when Tang Yi heard this story, his expression suddenly became strange.What the hell!This story is a bit familiar!Isn’t this the story of Lu You and Tang Wan?And what records their poignant love are the two songs about the hairpin-headed phoenix!"In the middle of the pool, it's like in my arms back then. It's been too many springs and autumns before we can hug each other. Before the flowers are in full bloom, I can see the sky turning red little by little..." Tang Yi almost sang out.Outside Shen Yuan, a certain sound is quite popular.But soon Tang Yi felt bad. It sounded like an open-book exam, but who knows what this little girl Kong Shilan was thinking?It would be nonsense if he asked everyone to write a poem praising this love story.No need to copy it!At this time, Kong Shilan's voice came: "Three years after General Lu and Miss Tang separated, barbarians from the north invaded the border. The court ordered General Lu to lead his army north to regain the lost territory." "Before the expedition, General Lu visited Shenyuan again and unexpectedly met Miss Tang." "Knowing that he was about to go on an expedition, Miss Tang drank wine as a reward.The general was on his way, and the general led his army northward to recover a large area of land occupied by the barbarians, and finally died in the battle.""Miss Tang received the bad news, fell seriously ill, and died with the general." Although many people knew this story, many girls from the aristocratic family still became red-eyed after hearing Kong Shilan's words.Kong Shilan pursed her lips and said: "Such a poignant love, but there are very few poems related to it..." It's over, it's over, I'm really afraid of whatever comes!Tang Yi's throat rolled subconsciously, he picked up the tea cup and took a sip of tea, but Kong Shilan said: "My topic is to write a poem or lyrics based on what General Lu was thinking when Miss Tang was toasting General Lu before leaving..." Poof!Tang Yi took a sip of tea and spat it out on the spot, then bent over and coughed violently.Everyone's eyes fell on Tang Yi.Even Kong Shilan's beautiful eyes looked over, and the corners of her lips raised a dangerous arc: "What? Does Xiao Shixian think my question is too easy?" "No, no..." Tang Yi waved his hands repeatedly.He raised his hand to wipe the tea from the corner of his mouth and said with a smile: "To be honest, I just didn't expect such a turn. I thought you asked us to write a poem praising this love." "Well, the turn is very good, very wonderful.
